snippet.title: Missy Mazzoli’s Lincoln in the Bardo: Live Stream Trailer
snippet.description:
On November 14, the Metropolitan Opera presents a free live stream on YouTube of Missy Mazzoli and librettist Royce Vavrek’s critically acclaimed new opera, based on the award-winning novel by George Saunders. Music Director Yannick Nézet-Séguin conducts the dazzling production by Lileana Blain-Cruz.

American composer Missy Mazzoli arrives at the Met with a bewitching adaptation of George Saunders’s Booker Prize–winning novel. Set in the “bardo,” the intermediate state between this life and the next, the opera examines Abraham Lincoln’s grief following the loss of his son and follows the boy as he struggles to move on to the next life. To tell this otherworldly story, Mazzoli crafts a score that draws inspiration from leading contemporary composers while conjuring a genre-defying sound-world distinctly her own.

This broadcast supports the company’s Make the Met Forever campaign. Every generation needs guardians of remarkable art, culture, and music. The powerful shared experience of opera—with its singular fusion of music, drama, dance, and design—is one of our greatest cultural treasures. Forever starts with you—make your gift today at https://metopera.org/support/make-the-met-forever/donate/?source=2439817

The captioned stream will remain available on YouTube through midnight ET on November 18.

Watch at https://youtube.com/live/RqtQ162dIqg

---

Guidance: Suggested for ages 13+

Lincoln in the Bardo contains adult themes and discussions of suicide. For more detail, read the complete synopsis: https://www.metopera.org/discover/synopses/lincoln-in-the-bardo/

This production contains flashing-light effects, atmospheric effects, and loud sound effects.

snippet.title: Gatto | Official Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
this cat’s on his last life...

Set in the feline-run underbelly of Venice, Italy, Gatto releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

Previously announced voice cast members Mark Ruffalo, Laurence Fishburne and Enrico Casarosa (who also serves as director) are joined by Bianca Babaşa as Maja; Sherry Cola as Regina; John Turturro as Capitano Briganti; Rumen Sali Shopov as Papu Janko; Rhys Darby as Focaccia; Isabella Rossellini as Contessa; Natasia Demetriou as Caronte; Jamie Demetriou as Plague Doctor; Jason Schwartzman as Vivaldi; Saverio Raimondo as Ugo; Jason Mantzoukas as Rico; Matt Jones as Enzo; Austin Madison as Fishmonger; Beatrice Manfredi as Martinelli; Jesse Andrews as Bartolomeo; Tracey Ullman as Luisa; and Marco Calvani as Maestro Foscari.

The original score for “Gatto” is composed by Academy Award®-winner Dario Marianelli (“Atonement”). The score features violin compositions co-written and performed by renowned Slovak violinist Barbora Botošová.

In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero (voiced by Mark Ruffalo) begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco (voiced by Laurence Fishburne), the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose – unless Venice gets the better of him first. “Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” 

Additionally, “Loving Dory,” a new animated short from Disney and Pixar set in the world of “Finding Nemo,” will play in theaters ahead of “Gatto.” Ellen DeGeneres returns as the voice of Dory in the short, which follows the forgetful blue tang fish as she finds herself in a hapless “meet-cute” with a plastic bag. Mistaking it for a gentle jellyfish, she's moved by its curious nature and falls head-over-fins in love. But it doesn't take long for her new romantic entanglement to escalate from a little clingy to outright toxic – and in desperate need of intervention! The short is written and directed by Lou Hamou-Lhadj, produced by Mary Alice Drumm and executive produced by Academy Award® winners Pete Docter and Andrew Stanton.

“Gatto” and “Loving Dory” release exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

snippet.title: Xbox 25th Anniversary DISASTER! Everyone HATES New Fable Gameplay Trailer Reveal!
snippet.description:
Xbox's 25th anniversary turned into a disaster. The $999 translucent green 25th Anniversary Xbox Series X sold out in seconds at midnight on the Microsoft Store, with no queue and no Xbox account limit. GameStop sold its stock for $4,950, and eBay scalpers flipped consoles for $1,500 to $2,500, all after Xbox CEO Asha Sharma claimed there was "more demand than consoles available." Then Playground Games dropped four minutes of new Fable gameplay for the anniversary, and fans are calling the Fable reboot generic, mostly walking and cutscenes, with none of the classic British humor, ahead of its February 23, 2027 launch on Xbox Series X|S, PS5, PC and Game Pass. Sharma's anniversary memo says game costs and risk "must change" and that "a small team will be able to build worlds that today demand hundreds of developers," which GameSpot says is about AI even if she won't say it, coming from the former Microsoft CoreAI executive behind Xbox layoffs, studio closures and Xbox Labs. Former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada, now head of SNK's VS Studio, said at the Console Game Developers Conference in Seoul, with a senior Xbox official in the audience, that he wishes the Xbox Series S had never been released, calling it "extra work for a slightly weaker child," while CD Projekt Red's Paweł Sasko half-defended it. The one bright spot is that MachineGames confirmed Wolfenstein 3 is in production. snippet.title: Goonies Pinball Official Trailer - Spooky Pinball
snippet.description:
HEY YOU GUYS!

The Goonies Pinball is a wide-body pinball machine that takes players deep into the treasure-filled world of the beloved 1985 adventure film, The Goonies!

From the Goon Docks of Astoria to the mysterious underground caverns beneath the Oregon coast, players will get to be a part of every step of this Goonie adventure, including outrunning the Fratellis, collecting "Rich Stuff," playing the Bone Organ, exploring the quarters of One-Eyed Willy, and of course, doing the Truffle Shuffle! Every twist and turn brings players one step closer to discovering the lost treasure of One-Eyed Willy and saving the Goon Docks!

Bringing this adventure to life is an incredible collection of authentic film footage, original movie dialogue, memorable music (including "The Goonies 'R' Good Enough" by Cyndi Lauper), and all the characters and moments that have made The Goonies a fan favorite for over 40 years.

Back at the helm of this adventure is Spooky Pinball's design duo, Spooky Luke and Corwin "Bug" Emery, joined by Luke Peters, combining their love of the film with a wide-body layout packed with flowing shots, interactive mechanisms, hidden surprises, and plenty of Goonie-sized fun!

Artist Christopher Franchi once again brings his incredible talents to the table, creating a stunning art package unlike any of his work you've seen before. It captures the characters, locations, and adventurous spirit of the film perfectly. Brady Hearn returns to deliver an immersive soundscape, while programmers Matt Kemp and Casey Butler bring the entire adventure together through fast-paced gameplay, exciting modes, and countless memorable moments.

So grab your treasure map, gather your fellow Goonies, and prepare for an adventure unlike any other.

Spookies Never Say Die!
